snippet.title: Draggin' Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3475110/Draggin/
Capture Draggins by draggin' the mouse in this casual arcade roguelite! Click-and-drag to cast spells on enemies and get your fill of wave battlin', achievement huntin', upgrade unlockin', rinse-and-repeatin'!

Join our Discord! - https://discord.gg/uBQSR4aXbX
Check out our Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/dragonfractalgames.com
Find us on Tiktok - https://www.tiktok.com/@dragonfractalgames
We're on Instagram as well - https://www.instagram.com/dragonfractalgames/

A game by Dragon Fractal Games
Alagard Font by Hewett Tsoi

#gamedev #indiegames #casualgames #dragon #roguelite #gaming #endless
